regulations.name: Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive
regulations.description: EU directive requiring large companies to disclose detailed sustainability information following the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS). Introduces double materiality and mandatory limited assurance.
regulations.scope: Large EU companies, listed SMEs, non-EU companies with >EUR 150M EU turnover
regulations.penalties: Member state-defined fines; potential director liability

regulations.name: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism
regulations.description: EU mechanism imposing a carbon price on imports of carbon-intensive goods to prevent carbon leakage and ensure fair competition with EU producers under the ETS.
regulations.scope: Importers of iron, steel, cement, aluminium, fertilisers, electricity, hydrogen
key_requirements: Purchase CBAM certificates matching embedded emissions
Quarterly reporting of imported goods and emissions
regulations.penalties: EUR 50 per tonne of unreported emissions; import ban for non-compliance

regulations.name: EU Taxonomy Regulation
regulations.description: Classification system establishing criteria for environmentally sustainable economic activities, guiding investors and companies on green investments.
regulations.scope: Companies subject to CSRD, financial market participants, EU member states
key_requirements: Substantial contribution to at least one environmental objective
Do no significant harm (DNSH) to other objectives
Disclose taxonomy-aligned revenue, CapEx, and OpEx
regulations.penalties: Greenwashing liability; regulatory enforcement by national authorities

regulations.name: Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation
regulations.description: EU regulation requiring financial market participants to disclose sustainability risks and adverse impacts in their investment decisions and financial products.
regulations.scope: Financial market participants and financial advisers in the EU
regulations.penalties: National competent authority sanctions; product reclassification

regulations.name: Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive
regulations.description: EU directive requiring large companies to identify, prevent, and mitigate adverse human rights and environmental impacts in their operations and value chains.
regulations.scope: EU companies with >1000 employees and >EUR 450M turnover; non-EU companies with equivalent EU turnover
key_requirements: Integrate due diligence into corporate policies
Identify and assess adverse impacts in value chain
Prevent, mitigate, and remediate adverse impacts
Monitor and publicly report on due diligence
regulations.penalties: Up to 5% of worldwide net turnover; civil liability for damages

regulations.name: EU Deforestation Regulation
regulations.description: EU regulation prohibiting the placing on the EU market of commodities and products linked to deforestation or forest degradation after December 2020.
regulations.scope: Operators and traders dealing in cattle, cocoa, coffee, palm oil, rubber, soya, wood, and derived products
key_requirements: Due diligence system with risk assessment
Due diligence statements before placing products on market
regulations.penalties: Fines proportionate to environmental damage; confiscation of products; market ban

regulations.name: EU Emissions Trading System
regulations.description: Cap-and-trade system limiting greenhouse gas emissions from energy-intensive industries, power generation, and aviation within the EU.
regulations.scope: Power stations, industrial plants, airlines operating in EU/EEA
key_requirements: Monitor and report annual GHG emissions
Surrender allowances equal to verified emissions
Comply with benchmark-based free allocation rules
regulations.penalties: EUR 100 per excess tonne (adjusted for inflation); name-and-shame publication

regulations.name: EU Battery Regulation
regulations.description: Comprehensive regulation covering the entire lifecycle of batteries placed on the EU market, from sustainable sourcing to end-of-life recycling.
regulations.scope: All batteries placed on the EU market (portable, automotive, EV, industrial)
key_requirements: Carbon footprint declaration and maximum thresholds
Supply chain due diligence for raw materials
regulations.penalties: National enforcement; market withdrawal; fines per member state law
